title: Divergent Realities: A Comparative Analysis of Human Expert vs. Artificial Intelligence Based Generation and Evaluation of Treatment Plans in Dermatology

bias_targets.methodology: Blinded, two-phase scoring of anonymized clinical treatment plans where human dermatology experts and an AI judge evaluated plans generated by both humans and AI models to detect systemic scoring preferences and divergences based on the evaluator's nature.

bias_targets.target: Cognitive bias (e.g., Confirmation bias, Status quo bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the systematic preference of human clinical experts for peer-generated plans over advanced, evidence-based AI-generated plans (the "o3 paradox") to identify reliance on familiar, experience-driven heuristics versus data-driven algorithmic optimality.
